references.text: Parallel text describing Bezalel's skills in stone and wood work and all kinds of craftsmanship, given by God.
Describes stone engraving and setting of precious stones, which relates to 'חֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן' (stone work) mentioned in the verse.
Mentions skilled works and crafts, including work with stone and wood, in connection with Bezalel's appointment.
Hiram from Tyre was filled with wisdom and understanding to perform all kinds of work in bronze, an example of craftsmanship given by God.
Huram-Abi is described as skilled in various materials and artistic work, parallel to the description of skills in Exodus.
The context of the verse, explaining that God filled Bezalel with God's Spirit, wisdom, and understanding to perform artistic work.
